profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Alexis Torres is a detail-oriented programmer and architect with 13+ years in the Software Development field. Advanced skills with leading-edge experience using .NET technologies such as C#, VB.NET, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, windows forms, Server controls, web services, .NET Framework, HTML5, CSS and IIS. Solid mathematical knowledge with experience developing comprehensive algorithms and data-processing logic.

Have been involved in the design and documentation of REST APIs for collection and retrieval of high volume telemetry data, Web application development using C# MVC5, and SQL. Had provided solutions for a wide range of industries, ranging from Government, electrical industries, Payment Processing Data & Analysis Industries, Medical and biotechnology industries, construction and general mechanical engineering. Performed troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of computer systems, hardware, peripherals, and telephony. Analyzed system requirements to efficiently isolate and resolve a wide array of technical issues. Participated in large-scale upgrades and installations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for leading the development of multiple software applications

positions.title: .NET Solution Engineer
positions.description: Coordinate design and implementation of web applications, collaborating with project managers, engineering teams, and clients to ensure on-time completion of project deliverables. Provide technical leadership to Junior Engineers, developing overall project architecture. Design Web applications and maintain content for .NET-based systems. Develop applications using Repository and Unit of Work Pattern in an ASP.NET MVC Application for federal and private sectors.

positions.title: Senior Web Application Developer
positions.description:
- Integrate Ajax and the latest web technologies on customers websites and including web components from Telerik.
- Interfaced with 3rd party applications and services, utilized custom in-house and off-the-shelf controls.
- Participated in user requirements gathering, project planning, design, implementation and testing.
- Analyzed server logs using C# Scripts to debug production issues and to supply metrics to clients.
- Provide recommendations to improve the software development process and introduced Agile
principles and practices.
- maintain in house applications and local SQL Databases, processes and stored procedures.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintain day to day operations of the system and fulfill the role of System Administrator while managing expectations and taking leadership of direction of the platform. Deploy customization's to the system as needed to suit our evolving business needs. Played vital role in brainstorming, mapping, and creating processes in conjunction with employees to develop and upgrade system needs. Create ASP.NET web forms and Class libraries containing code for business and data access logic using C#.NET. Developed back end Database using SQL Server 2014. Provided administration duties on SQL Server. Create, maintain and backup and restore database.

positions.title: MES Consultant Werum PAS-X
positions.description: My goal as a manufacturing execution system expert is to improve productivity and reduce cycle-time, the total time to produce an order. By integrating an MES with ERP software, factory managers can be proactive about ensuring the delivery of quality products in a timely, cost-effective manner. Engage with customers at all levels (VP, Director, Manager, etc.) to understand the business needs. Create add-on business to existing assignments and customers

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant
positions.description:
- Design, develop, test, deliver and maintain portable protocol application programming interfaces and software/firmware to enable various networking applications. 
- Measure performance and optimize networking software components. 
- Support hardware and software validation by providing problem solving skills in analyzing and fixing problems. 
- Participate in design, code and documentation reviews. 
- Develop and run unit tests. 
- Develop user level and design level software documentation. 
- Work cooperatively, efficiently and effectively with others.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Sparkative Project

Contributed in software engineering expertise in the development of products through the software lifecycle, from requirements definition through successful deployment. Facilitated customization of systems by encouraging software engineering team to adopt emerging standards for software application development architecture and tools. Participated in sales presentations due to ability to translate user needs into easy-to-understand software solutions. Excelled in rapid application development and management of technological issues for assigned projects, earning the highest customer satisfaction rating for all software solutions delivered. Introduced methodologies and best practices that enhanced product definition, release processes and customization of applications to user needs. Provided user requirements analysis, design and programming support to our clients.

company.name: Inter Metro Cupey | Microsoft Innovation Center

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description: Responsible for the maintenance of servers and analyze problems in databases.  Client Support expert on PAYTECH Virtual Terminal. Responsible for quality assurance of finished websites including the validation of web forms and integration.  Met and corresponded with clients to determine client needs for company sites and problems with the company payments processing Gateway.

projects.description: (SIMERA Project) Internal Application to manage actuarial analysis
